### Observed differences

- A14 is no longer observed in the later window: before, it was executed exactly once in every case (200 of 200 traces, mean 1.0 occurrence per trace) near the end of the case; in the later window it appears in 0 of 200 traces. [OCC003, POS006]
- The flow into and out of A14 disappeared with it: before, every observed outgoing transition of A03 went to A14, and A06 led to A14 in about 48 in 100 of its transitions (A03 took most of the rest); in the later window A06 always leads to A03, A03 shows no observed outgoing transitions and is now the final event in every case. [DIR002, DIR004, DIR010, POS002]
- A01 is new: absent from all 200 earlier traces, it appears in about 56 in 100 later traces, on average about 2.4 times per trace (so it repeats within cases), around the middle of the case (median position about 0.49 of the trace). [OCC001, POS001]
- In the later window A01 works as a hub: its outgoing transitions split almost evenly over A09, A02, A11 and A05 (about 23–27 in 100 each); A09 and A13, which previously led to A02 or A11, now lead exclusively to A01, and A08, A10 and A17 lead to A01 in roughly 53–58 in 100 of their transitions (previously mainly to A06, A13, A09 or A02). [DIR001, DIR005, DIR006, DIR007, DIR009, DIR011]
- Relations mirror both shifts: before, A01 never co-occurred with any of A02, A03, A05, A06, A08–A13, A16 or A17; after, it co-occurs with them in roughly 20–56 in 100 traces. Pairs involving A14 inverted: A03–A14 and A06–A14 co-occurred in every earlier case, but in the later window A14 is never present and the partner appears alone in most cases (A03 alone and A06 alone each in 100 in 100 traces). [REL002, REL004, REL011, REL015, REL017, REL023, REL026, REL028, REL031, REL033, REL035, REL036, REL037]
- A05 is executed less often: present in about 62 in 100 earlier traces (mean about 2.0 occurrences per trace) versus about 29 in 100 later traces (mean about 1.2). [OCC002]
- Routing around A05 changed: A05's successor switched from A16 (about 49 in 100 of its transitions) to A13 (about 49 in 100), and A11's successor switched from A05 (about 54 in 100) to A16 (about 50 in 100); A05 now co-occurs with A03, A06 or A11 in only about 24–29 in 100 traces, versus about 62 in 100 before. A06 and A11 also sit slightly later within cases, and many pairwise step gaps were redistributed (e.g., A06 now always reaches A03 within one step, previously one or two). [OCC002, DIR003, DIR008, REL016, REL018, REL020, POS003, POS005, LAG015]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility of a structural change in which A14 is no longer executed and A01 is added as a new, repeated, mid-process hub. Before, A14 ran exactly once in every case near the end, fed by A03 (all of whose transitions went to A14) and by A06 (split about evenly between A03 and A14); in the later window A14 is not observed in any of 200 traces, A03 has become the final event, and A06 always flows to A03. In the same later window A01, unobserved before, runs in about 56 in 100 cases about 2.4 times per case around the middle, receiving flow from A08, A09, A10, A13 and A17 (A09 and A13 exclusively) and passing it on to A11, A09, A05 and A02 in roughly equal shares. [OCC001, OCC003, POS001, POS002, POS006, DIR001, DIR002, DIR004, DIR005, DIR006, DIR007, DIR009, DIR010, DIR011, REL011, REL017, REL026]

The screening produced 129 qualifying items where fewer than 1 would be expected without change, and the occurrence, position, direction and relation indicators all point consistently to the same two activities. Limitations: zero participation only shows that A14 was not observed in the later sample, not that it cannot occur, and many items (especially the A14 relation pairs) describe the same traces, so they are not independent confirmations. An important competing explanation the evidence cannot rule out is a shift in the mix of cases — for example, the later window being dominated by cases of a type that never executes A14 — rather than a modification of the process itself.

Other differences: A05's participation dropped from about 62 in 100 to about 29 in 100 traces and its surroundings were rerouted — A05 now leads to A13 instead of A16, A11 leads to A16 instead of A05, and A05 co-occurs far less with A03, A06 and A11; A06 and A11 also occur slightly later within cases, and many pairwise step gaps shifted. These fit the same restructuring but are not part of the main hypothesis as stated. [OCC002, DIR003, DIR008, REL016, REL018, REL020, POS003, POS005, LAG015]
